blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Palace press officer Claire Castro on Thursday said the lack of attention from Vice President Sara Duterte’s camp may explain why the vice president appears “clueless” about the administration’s programs. The remarks came after Duterte’s new spokesperson, Salvador Paolo Panelo Jr., said Castro was not a factor in his appointment and that he had no intention of going head-to-head with her over every statement, as he only needed to address serious criticisms. Panelo also described Castro as someone who is “hard to take seriously.” READ: Sara Duterte camp: Hard to take Claire Castro seriously For Castro, however, Panelo’s remarks […]...
